license_decisions.summary: Maintainer approved publishing v0.4 without a general copyright license grant. No root LICENSE file is published; project-authored SPDX remains NOASSERTION and redistribution is classified as publish-without-license-grant. Public access or cloning grants no permission to use, modify, or redistribute project-authored material. A prior MIT draft was withdrawn. Any future license grant requires a separate explicit decision and repository update.
Scenario data under inputs/original-plan is constrained by CC-BY-4.0 for that scenario data only; it does not license repository code, D-group materials, or source ZIP archives.

Maintainer approved redistribution of D-group received Shape/note and the byte-copy v0.4 Shape with the public candidate once published. File-level SPDX remains NOASSERTION where D group did not supply a separate SPDX grant; see NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_MATERIALS.md.

Maintainer approved redistribution of both source ZIP archives with the public candidate once published and accepted disclosure of ZIP-internal historical absolute paths covered by the privacy allowlist. File-level SPDX for ZIP bytes remains NOASSERTION.
